title: BeforeModel input
description: Fires before each model request of an agent conversation (provider wrapper). Name from Gemini CLI (sources/gemini-cli-2026-10-30.md:191); payload specific to Zed.

request_id.description: Identifier of the model request, shared by BeforeModel, AfterModel and ZedModelError.

intent.description: Zed CompletionIntent of the request, snake_case; null when Zed sets none.

is_compaction.description: True when the request is the compaction summary (recognised by its instruction, not by intent alone).

new_messages.description: Non-system messages of this request not yet sent to THIS hook for this thread. Computed per hook (key: thread id + handler identity), comparing non-system messages only, independently of the model. Never the whole conversation, including for the compaction request and the panel summary.

known_message_count.description: Number of non-system messages of this request already sent to this hook for this thread.

tool_names.description: Names of the tools declared in this request, sorted; may be empty.

skill_names.description: Zed extension. Names of the skills in the <available_skills> catalogue of this request's system message, sorted; empty when there is no catalogue. Covers every source Zed reads (built-in skills, ~/.agents/skills, the .agents/skills of each open project), so a hook need not guess them. These are the names remove_skills accepts.

total_message_count.description: Number of messages in the request.

max_output_tokens.description: Output token ceiling of the request (Zed effective_max_output_tokens), null when the provider default applies.
